fusions.name: Gaff
fusions.desc: Gaffs a target already on your hook: it needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. The gaff deals 10 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Longline
fusions.desc: Casts 4 baited hooks in a spread out to 6 tiles. Each hook deals 4 damage, stuns the target for 0.8 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Funnel Weir
fusions.desc: Stakes a weir 5 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds. It drags every enemy near it inward and leaves each [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Hauled In
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 6 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
